hints.title: Row-wise Peak Extraction
hints.text: In each step, every row loses its currently remaining maximum value.

hints.title: Sorting Each Row
hints.text: Sorting each row ascending allows direct access to the maximum remaining element at matching column indices.

hints.title: Column-wise Maximums
hints.text: After sorting all rows, taking the maximum of each column and summing them yields the final answer.

hints.title: Matrix Row Sorting Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting each row in-place followed by column-wise scanning.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching for max elements without sorting takes O(m * n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond input arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that sorting all rows aligns the removals chronologically across columns.
